users_profile.description: This table stores user profile information including bio.
users_profile.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Each user profile belongs to one specific institution.

users_profileinstitution.description: This table creates a many-to-many relationship between user profiles and institutions.
users_profileinstitution.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Allows users to be associated with multiple institutions.

users_role.description: This table defines roles for users/employees can have in the system.
users_role.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Each role is institution-specific.

users_rolepermission.description: This table maps permissions to roles, defining what each role can do.
users_rolepermission.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_role.institution_id. Access institution through role_id → users_role → institution_institution.

users_userrole.description: This table assigns roles to users, determining their access levels.
users_userrole.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_role.institution_id. Access institution through role_id → users_role → institution_institution.

users_signature.description: This table stores digital signatures for users.
users_signature.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access institution through user_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

institution_institutionkycdocument.description: This table stores KYC (Know Your Customer) verification documents for institutions.
institution_institutionkycdocument.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Contains verification and compliance documents.

institution_institutionbanktype.description: This table defines bank types and codes available for the institution.
institution_institutionbanktype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Specifies which banks the institution can use.

institution_institutionbankaccount.description: This table stores bank account information for institutions.
institution_institutionbankaccount.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutionbanktype.institution_id. Access institution through institution_bank_id → institution_institutionbanktype → institution_institution.

institution_institutionworkingdays.description: This table defines the working days for institutions.
institution_institutionworkingdays.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Sets institution-wide working schedule.

institution_institutionday.description: This table stores specific day details (opening/closing times) for institution working days.
institution_institutionday.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutionworkingdays.institution_id. Access institution through institution_working_days_id → institution_institutionworkingdays → institution_institution.

institution_institutiontax.description: This table defines tax configurations and rules for institutions.
institution_institutiontax.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific tax settings.

institution_employeetaxtype.description: This table links employee types to tax configurations.
institution_employeetaxtype.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutiontax.institution_id. Access institution through tax_id → institution_institutiontax → institution_institution.

institution_taxmonths.description: This table defines which months taxes apply for specific tax rules.
institution_taxmonths.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutiontax.institution_id. Access institution through tax_id → institution_institutiontax → institution_institution.

institution_institutiontaxrule.description: This table stores specific tax calculation rules and formulas.
institution_institutiontaxrule.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutiontax.institution_id. Access institution through institution_tax_id → institution_institutiontax → institution_institution.

institution_branch.description: It represents physical branches of an institution.
institution_branch.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Branches belong to one institution.

institution_branchworkingdays.description: This table defines working days schedule for specific branches.
institution_branchworkingdays.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_branchday.description: This table stores specific day details for branch working schedules.
institution_branchday.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branchworkingdays → institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_working_days_id → institution_branchworkingdays → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_branchshift.description: This table defines work shifts for branches.
institution_branchshift.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_userbranch.description: This table links users to branches they are assigned to.
institution_userbranch.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_department.description: This table defines departments within an institution (HR, IT, Sales, etc).
institution_department.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Departments belong to one institution.

institution_branchdepartment.description: This links departments to branches (many-to-many relationship).
institution_branchdepartment.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_institutionpenaltyconfig.description: This table stores penalty (late_coming, early_leaving, absent, no_response_spotcheck, late_spotcheck_response) configurations at the institution level.
institution_institutionpenaltyconfig.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-wide penalty rules.

institution_branchpenaltyconfig.description: This table stores penalty (late_coming, early_leaving, absent, no_response_spotcheck, late_spotcheck_response) configurations at the branch level.
institution_branchpenaltyconfig.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_branchlocationcomparisonconf.description: This table stores geolocation verification settings for branches (check-in radius).
institution_branchlocationcomparisonconf.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access institution through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

institution_ownershiptransfer.description: This tracks ownership transfer history for institutions.
institution_ownershiptransfer.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Records when institution ownership changes hands.

institution_usergroup.description: This table defines groups of employees.
institution_usergroup.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee. Access institution through employees → employee → institution (via department or branch).

institution_usergroupemployee.description: This table links employees to user groups (many-to-many).
institution_usergroupemployee.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee. Access institution through employee_id → employee → institution (via department or branch).

institution_institutionsmssetting.description: This table stores SMS notification settings for institutions.
institution_institutionsmssetting.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-wide SMS configuration.

institution_smsusergroup.description: This table links SMS settings to user groups for targeted notifications.
institution_smsusergroup.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutionsmssetting.institution_id. Access institution through institution_setting_id → institution_institutionsmssetting → institution_institution.

employeetype.description: This table defines types of employees (Full-time, Part-time, Contract, etc).
employeetype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Employee type classifications per institution.

worktype.description: This defines work types (Remote, On-site, Hybrid, etc).
worktype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Work type classifications per institution.

employeebankaccount.description: It stores employee bank account details used for salary payments.
employeebankaccount.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employeenextofkin.description: This table stores emergency contact information for employees.
employeenextofkin.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employeechild.description: This table stores information about employees' children.
employeechild.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employeespouse.description: This table stores information about employees' spouses.
employeespouse.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employeeeducation.description: This table stores educational qualifications of employees.
employeeeducation.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employeeworkexperience.description: This table stores previous work experience of employees.
employeeworkexperience.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employee.description: This table stores core employee information including personal details, position, salary etc.
employee.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_department.institution_id. Access through department_id → institution_department → institution_institution.

employee_supervisor.description: This stores supervisors of an employee.
employee_supervisor.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee and institution_department. Access through target_employees/target_departments → institution.

employeeworkingdays.description: This table defines custom working days for specific employees.
employeeworkingdays.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employeeday.description: This table stores specific day details for employee working schedules.
employeeday.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee_employeeworkingdays → employee → institution. Access through employee_working_days_id → employee_employeeworkingdays → employee → institution.

employeeshift.description: This stores shifts to employees in type of REQUEST or ALLOCATION.
employeeshift.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branchshift → institution_branch. Access through shift_id → institution_branchshift → institution_branch → institution_institution.

employeeattendance.description: This table records daily employee attendance with check-in/check-out times.
employeeattendance.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employeecontract.description: This table stores employment contracts for employees.
employeecontract.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

documentrequest.description: This table tracks requests for documents from employees.
documentrequest.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee. Access through employees → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employeedocumentrequest.description: This table links document requests to specific employees with status tracking.
employeedocumentrequest.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employeerequesteddocument.description: This table stores actual documents submitted by employees in response to requests.
employeerequesteddocument.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee_documentrequestemployee → employee → institution. Access through document_request_employee_id → employee_documentrequestemployee → employee → institution.

onboarding_onboarding.description: This table tracks onboarding process for new hires.
onboarding_onboarding.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobadvertapplication → recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through application_id chain to institution_institution.

onboarding_terminationstage.description: This table defines stages in the employee termination process.
onboarding_terminationstage.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific termination workflow stages.

onboarding_terminationtype.description: This table defines types of termination (Resignation, Retirement, Dismissal, etc).
onboarding_terminationtype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific termination types.

onboarding_terminationtypestage.description: This table links termination types to their required stages.
onboarding_terminationtypestage.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via onboarding_terminationtype.institution_id. Access through termination_type_id → onboarding_terminationtype → institution_institution.

onboarding_offboarding.description: This table tracks the employee exit/termination process.
onboarding_offboarding.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department → institution_institution.

onboarding_offboardingstageprogress.description: This table tracks progress through offboarding stages for each employee.
onboarding_offboardingstageprogress.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via onboarding_offboarding → employee → institution. Access through offboarding_id → onboarding_offboarding → employee → institution.

onboarding_handoverreport.description: This table stores handover reports submitted during offboarding.
onboarding_handoverreport.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via onboarding_offboarding → employee → institution. Access through offboarding_id → onboarding_offboarding → employee → institution.

recruitment_jobposition.description: This table defines job positions/titles within the organization.
recruitment_jobposition.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_department.institution_id. Access through department_id → institution_department → institution_institution.

recruitment_jobpositionadvert.description: This table represents job advertisements/postings for open positions.
recruitment_jobpositionadvert.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_position_id → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department → institution_institution.

recruitment_jobadvertapplication.description: This table stores job applications from candidates.
recruitment_jobadvertapplication.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_position_advert_id chain to institution_institution.

recruitment_applicationdocument.description: This table stores documents uploaded by job applicants (CV, certificates, etc).
recruitment_applicationdocument.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobadvertapplication → recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_advert_application_id chain to institution_institution.

recruitment_interviewstage.description: This table defines interview stages for job positions (screening, technical, HR, etc).
recruitment_interviewstage.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_position_advert_id chain to institution_institution.

recruitment_jobinterview.description: This table schedules and tracks individual interviews for applicants.
recruitment_jobinterview.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobadvertapplication → recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_position_application_id chain to institution_institution.

recruitment_skillzonecategory.description: This table categorizes skill zones for talent management.
recruitment_skillzonecategory.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific skill categorization.

recruitment_skillzone.description: This table tracks candidate skills and potential value.
recruitment_skillzone.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobadvertapplication → recruitment_jobpositionadvert → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through candidate_id chain to institution_institution.

discipline_disciplinaryaction.description: This table records disciplinary actions taken against employees.
discipline_disciplinaryaction.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

leave_types.description: This table defines types of leave (Annual, Sick, Maternity, etc).
leave_types.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific leave types.

leave_balances.description: This table tracks leave balances for each employee per leave type per year.
leave_balances.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Tracks leave balances by institution.

leave_applications.description: This table stores leave requests submitted by employees.
leave_applications.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Leave applications are tracked at institution level.

leave_policies.description: This table defines leave policies and rules for leave types.
leave_policies.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific leave policies.

leave_mgt_outofoffice.description: This table tracks when employees are out of office temporarily.
leave_mgt_outofoffice.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

payroll_allowancetype.description: This table defines types of allowances (Housing, Transport, Medical, etc).
payroll_allowancetype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific allowance types.

payroll_deductiontype.description: This table defines types of deductions (Loan, Tax, Insurance, etc).
payroll_deductiontype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Institution-specific deduction types.

payroll_employeeallowance.description: It stores allowances to specific employees.
payroll_employeeallowance.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

payroll_employeededuction.description: It stores deductions to specific employees.
payroll_employeededuction.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

payroll_employeetax.description: It stores tax configurations to employees.
payroll_employeetax.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_institutiontax.institution_id. Access through institution_tax_id → institution_institutiontax → institution_institution.

payroll_employeepenalty.description: This table records penalties applied to employees (late arrival, early departure, etc).
payroll_employeepenalty.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

payroll_penaltywaiverequest.description: This table tracks requests to waive/cancel employee penalties.
payroll_penaltywaiverequest.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_employeepenalty → employee → institution. Access through penalty_id → payroll_employeepenalty → employee → institution.

payroll_payrollperiod.description: This table defines payroll processing periods (monthly, bi-weekly, etc).
payroll_payrollperiod.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Payroll periods are institution-specific.

payroll_payrollperiodtargetjobposition.description: This table links payroll periods to target job positions for processing.
payroll_payrollperiodtargetjobposition.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_payrollperiod.institution_id. Access through payroll_period_id → payroll_payrollperiod → institution_institution.

payroll_payrollperiodtargetbranch.description: This table links payroll periods to target branches for processing.
payroll_payrollperiodtargetbranch.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_payrollperiod.institution_id OR institution_branch.institution_id. Access through payroll_period_id → payroll_payrollperiod → institution_institution.

payroll_payrollperiodtargetdepartment.description: This table links payroll periods to target departments for processing.
payroll_payrollperiodtargetdepartment.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_payrollperiod.institution_id OR institution_department.institution_id. Access through payroll_period_id → payroll_payrollperiod → institution_institution.

payroll_payrollperiodtargetemployee.description: This table links payroll periods to specific target employees for processing.
payroll_payrollperiodtargetemployee.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_payrollperiod.institution_id. Access through payroll_period_id → payroll_payrollperiod → institution_institution.

payroll_payslip.description: This table generates payslips for employees showing salary breakdown.
payroll_payslip.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution AND payroll_payrollperiod.institution_id. Access through employee_id → employee → institution OR payroll_period_id → payroll_payrollperiod → institution_institution.

payroll_payslipitem.description: This table stores individual line items on payslips (allowances, deductions, etc).
payroll_payslipitem.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via payroll_payslip → payroll_payrollperiod OR employee. Access through payslip_id → payroll_payslip → institution.

performance_period.description: This table defines performance review periods (quarterly, annually, etc).
performance_period.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Performance periods are institution-specific.

performance_objectives.description: This table defines organizational objectives and goals.
performance_objectives.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Objectives are set at institution level.

performance_employeeobjectives.description: This table assigns objectives to employees for tracking.
performance_employeeobjectives.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution OR performance_objectives.institution_id. Access through employee_id → employee → institution OR objective_id → performance_objectives → institution_institution.

performance_keyresult.description: This table defines key results/KPIs for measuring objectives.
performance_keyresult.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Key results are institution-specific.

performance_feedback360.description: This table stores 360-degree feedback between employees.
performance_feedback360.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution OR performance_period.institution_id. Access through reviewer_id/given_by_id → employee → institution OR period_id → performance_period → institution_institution.

performance_employeebonuspoint.description: This table tracks bonus points awarded to employees.
performance_employeebonuspoint.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

performance_questiontemplate.description: This table stores question templates for performance reviews.
performance_questiontemplate.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Question templates are institution-specific.

performance_bonuspointsettings.description: This table configures conditions for awarding bonus points.
performance_bonuspointsettings.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Bonus point rules are institution-specific.

performance_meeting.description: This table schedules and tracks performance review meetings.
performance_meeting.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Meetings are organized at institution level.

performance_performanceconcerntype.description: This table defines types of performance concerns/issues.
performance_performanceconcerntype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Performance concern categories are institution-specific.

performance_performanceconcern.description: This table records specific performance concerns/issues.
performance_performanceconcern.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via performance_performanceconcerntype.institution_id. Access through category_id → performance_performanceconcerntype → institution_institution.

performance_pipsupportresourcetype.description: This table defines types of support resources for Performance Improvement Plans.
performance_pipsupportresourcetype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. PIP support resource types are institution-specific.

performance_pipsupportresource.description: This table stores specific support resources for PIPs (training, mentoring, etc).
performance_pipsupportresource.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via performance_pipsupportresourcetype.institution_id. Access through type_id → performance_pipsupportresourcetype → institution_institution.

performance_performanceimprovementplan.description: This table manages Performance Improvement Plans for underperforming employees.
performance_performanceimprovementplan.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

performance_pipemployeeobjectives.description: This table assigns specific objectives to employees under PIP.
performance_pipemployeeobjectives.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

projects_project.description: This table manages projects within the organization.
projects_project.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Projects belong to one institution.

projects_projectdocument.description: This table stores documents related to projects.
projects_projectdocument.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via projects_project.institution_id. Access through project_id → projects_project → institution_institution.

projects_task.description: This table manages tasks within projects.
projects_task.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via projects_project.institution_id. Access through project_id → projects_project → institution_institution.

projects_taskdocument.description: This table stores documents related to project tasks.
projects_taskdocument.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via projects_task → projects_project. Access through task_id → projects_task → projects_project → institution_institution.

projects_tasktimesheet.description: This table tracks time spent on project tasks.
projects_tasktimesheet.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via projects_task → projects_project. Access through task_id → projects_task → projects_project → institution_institution.

calendar2_publicholiday.description: This table defines public holidays for the institution.
calendar2_publicholiday.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Public holidays are institution-specific.

calendar2_event.description: This table manages calendar events for the institution.
calendar2_event.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Events are organized at institution level.

calendar2_eventoccurrence.description: This table tracks specific occurrences of recurring events.
calendar2_eventoccurrence.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via calendar2_event.institution_id. Access through event_id → calendar2_event → institution_institution.

calendar2_calendar.description: This table represents yearly calendars with holidays and events.
calendar2_calendar.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Calendars are institution-specific.

assets_assetcategory.description: This table categorizes assets (IT Equipment, Furniture, Vehicles, etc).
assets_assetcategory.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Asset categories are institution-specific.

assets_asset.description: This table manages physical assets owned by the institution.
assets_asset.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Assets belong to one institution.

assets_assetrequest.description: This table tracks employee requests for assets.
assets_assetrequest.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via assets_asset.institution_id. Access through asset_id → assets_asset → institution_institution.

assets_assetallocation.description: This table tracks asset assignments to employees.
assets_assetallocation.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via assets_asset.institution_id. Access through asset_id → assets_asset → institution_institution.

assets_assetreturn.description: This table records asset returns from employees.
assets_assetreturn.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via assets_asset.institution_id. Access through asset_id → assets_asset → institution_institution.

assets_assethistory.description: This table maintains audit trail for asset movements and changes.
assets_assethistory.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via assets_asset.institution_id. Access through asset_id → assets_asset → institution_institution.

documents_documenttype.description: This table defines document types (Contract, Letter, Report, etc).
documents_documenttype.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Document types are institution-specific.

documents_documenttemplate.description: This table stores reusable document templates with placeholders.
documents_documenttemplate.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via documents_documenttype.institution_id. Access through document_type_id → documents_documenttype → institution_institution.

documents_document.description: This table stores generated documents from templates with filled placeholders.
documents_document.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via documents_documenttemplate → documents_documenttype. Access through document_template_id → documents_documenttemplate → documents_documenttype → institution_institution.

settings_systemconfiguration.description: This table stores system-wide configuration settings.
settings_systemconfiguration.institution_relation: NONE: Global system settings not tied to specific institutions.

settings_systemday.description: This table defines system-level day definitions (Monday, Tuesday, etc).
settings_systemday.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data not tied to specific institutions.

settings_systemmonth.description: This table defines system-level month definitions (January, February, etc).
settings_systemmonth.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data not tied to specific institutions.

settings_meetingintegration.description: This table stores integration settings for meeting platforms (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet).
settings_meetingintegration.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Meeting integrations are institution-specific.

settings_emailproviderconfig.description: This table configures email provider settings for company email management.
settings_emailproviderconfig.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Email provider configurations are institution-specific.

settings_draft.description: This table stores draft/unsaved changes before submission.
settings_draft.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access through user_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

settings_recyclebin.description: This table stores soft-deleted records for potential recovery.
settings_recyclebin.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Recycle bin is institution-specific.

approval_action.description: This table defines types of approval actions (Create, Update, Delete, etc).
approval_action.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data for approval workflows.

approval_approvergroup.description: This table groups users and roles who can approve certain actions.
approval_approvergroup.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Approver groups are institution-specific.

approval_approvergrouprole.description: This table links roles to approver groups (many-to-many).
approval_approvergrouprole.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvergroup.institution_id. Access through approver_group_id → approval_approvergroup → institution_institution.

approval_approvergroupuser.description: This table links users to approver groups (many-to-many).
approval_approvergroupuser.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvergroup.institution_id. Access through approver_group_id → approval_approvergroup → institution_institution.

approval_approvaldocument.description: This table defines which document types require approval workflows.
approval_approvaldocument.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Approval document configurations are institution-specific.

approval_approvaldocumentlevel.description: This table defines approval levels/stages for documents (Level 1, Level 2, etc).
approval_approvaldocumentlevel.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvaldocument.institution_id. Access through approval_document_id → approval_approvaldocument → institution_institution.

approval_approvaldocumentlevelapprovers.description: This table links approvers to specific approval document levels.
approval_approvaldocumentlevelapprovers.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvaldocumentlevel → approval_approvaldocument. Access through approval_document_level_id → approval_approvaldocumentlevel → approval_approvaldocument → institution_institution.

approval_approvaldocumentleveloverriders.description: This table links users who can override approvals at specific levels.
approval_approvaldocumentleveloverriders.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvaldocumentlevel → approval_approvaldocument. Access through approval_document_level_id → approval_approvaldocumentlevel → approval_approvaldocument → institution_institution.

approval_approval.description: This table tracks individual approval requests for documents/records.
approval_approval.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approvaldocument.institution_id. Access through document_id → approval_approvaldocument → institution_institution.

approval_approvaltask.description: This table tracks approval tasks assigned to approvers at each level.
approval_approvaltask.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via approval_approval → approval_approvaldocument. Access through approval_id → approval_approval → approval_approvaldocument → institution_institution.

spotcheck_institutionspotchecksetting.description: This table configures spot check settings at institution level (random attendance verification).
spotcheck_institutionspotchecksetting.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Spot check settings are institution-wide.

spotcheck_branchspotchecksetting.description: This table configures spot check settings at branch level.
spotcheck_branchspotchecksetting.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id. Access through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

spotcheck_employeespotchecksetting.description: This table configures custom spot check settings for individual employees.
spotcheck_employeespotchecksetting.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

spotcheck_spotcheckstatus.description: This table defines statuses for spot checks (Pending, Responded, Expired, etc).
spotcheck_spotcheckstatus.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data for spot check statuses.

spotcheck_employeespotcheck.description: This table records individual spot check instances sent to employees.
spotcheck_employeespotcheck.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

communication_notification.description: This table stores in-app notifications sent to users.
communication_notification.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access through user_id_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

communication_announcement.description: This table manages company-wide or targeted announcements.
communication_announcement.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via target entities (employee, institution_department, recruitment_jobposition). Access through target relationships to institution_institution.

communication_employeeannouncementacknow.description: This table tracks which employees have acknowledged announcements.
communication_employeeannouncementacknow.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

communication_notes.description: This table stores personal notes created by users.
communication_notes.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access through owner_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

helpdesk_faqcategory.description: This table categorizes FAQ entries for the helpdesk system.
helpdesk_faqcategory.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. FAQ categories are institution-specific.

helpdesk_faq.description: This table stores frequently asked questions and answers.
helpdesk_faq.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via helpdesk_faqcategory.institution_id. Access through category_id → helpdesk_faqcategory → institution_institution.

helpdesk_ticketcategory.description: This table categorizes support tickets (IT, HR, Facilities, etc).
helpdesk_ticketcategory.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution. Ticket categories are institution-specific.

helpdesk_ticket.description: This table manages support tickets submitted by users.
helpdesk_ticket.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via helpdesk_ticketcategory.institution_id. Access through category_id → helpdesk_ticketcategory → institution_institution.

helpdesk_ticketcomment.description: This table stores comments/replies on support tickets.
helpdesk_ticketcomment.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via helpdesk_ticket → helpdesk_ticketcategory. Access through ticket_id → helpdesk_ticket → helpdesk_ticketcategory → institution_institution.

helpdesk_ticketattachment.description: This table stores file attachments for support tickets.
helpdesk_ticketattachment.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via helpdesk_ticket → helpdesk_ticketcategory. Access through ticket_id → helpdesk_ticket → helpdesk_ticketcategory → institution_institution.

devices_device.description: This table manages physical devices (biometric scanners, attendance terminals).
devices_device.institution_relation: DIRECT: institution_id → institution_institution AND INDIRECT via institution_branch. Devices belong to institution and can be assigned to branches.

devices_deviceemployeeattachment.description: This table links employees to devices for biometric enrollment.
devices_deviceemployeeattachment.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via devices_device.institution_id OR employee → institution. Access through device_id → devices_device → institution_institution.

systems_partnersystem.description: This table defines external partner systems available for integration.
systems_partnersystem.institution_relation: NONE: Global system catalog. Actual institution connections are in institution_institutionpartnersystem.

users_customuser.description: This table contains information about the users that can login into the system.
users_customuser.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_profile.institution_id. Access through user profile relationship to institution_institution.

users_onetimepassword.description: This table stores OTP codes for authentication and password resets.
users_onetimepassword.institution_relation: NONE: OTP is user-level security, not directly tied to institutions.

users_permissioncategory.description: This table categorizes permissions for better organization.
users_permissioncategory.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data for permission categorization.

users_permission.description: This table defines granular permissions in the system.
users_permission.institution_relation: NONE: Global system permissions, applied per institution through roles.

users_userpermission.description: This table assigns specific permissions directly to users (bypassing roles).
users_userpermission.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access through user_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

users_otpmodel.description: This table stores OTP verification codes for users.
users_otpmodel.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via users_customuser → users_profile.institution_id. Access through user_id → users_customuser → users_profile → institution_institution.

users_systemtype.description: This table defines types of systems in the application.

users_system.description: This table defines system instances with API keys.
users_system.institution_relation: NONE: System-level configuration. Institutions reference this via institution.system_id.

recruitment_requireddocument.description: This table defines required documents for job positions or other entities.
recruitment_requireddocument.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via GenericForeignKey to various models. Access through content_object relationship chain to institution_institution.

recruitment_jobpositiondocumenttemplate.description: This table links document templates to job positions for specific purposes.
recruitment_jobpositiondocumenttemplate.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via recruitment_jobposition → institution_department. Access through job_position_id → recruitment_jobposition → institution_department → institution_institution.

employee_qualificationaward.description: This table defines educational qualification types (Diploma, Bachelor's, Master's, etc).
employee_qualificationaward.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data for education levels.

employee_employeebirthdaytask.description: This table tracks scheduled tasks for employee birthday notifications.
employee_employeebirthdaytask.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employee_supervisoremployee.description: This table links supervisors to their supervised employees (many-to-many).
employee_supervisoremployee.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee_supervisor and employee relationships to institution.

employee_employeesupervisor.description: This table assigns supervisors to employees.
employee_employeesupervisor.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → department/branch → institution_institution.

employee_employeecheckinbranch.description: This table defines which branches an employee can check in at (many-to-many).
employee_employeecheckinbranch.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via institution_branch.institution_id OR employee → institution. Access through branch_id → institution_branch → institution_institution.

employee_employeecompanyemail.description: This table manages company email accounts for employees.
employee_employeecompanyemail.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employee_employeemonthlyhouraccount.description: This table aggregates monthly working hours, overtime, and absences for employees.
employee_employeemonthlyhouraccount.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

employee_employeelogs.description: This table logs employee device interactions and attendance records.
employee_employeelogs.institution_relation: INDIRECT: Via employee → institution. Access through employee_id → employee → branch → institution_institution.

discipline_disciplinetype.description: This table defines types of disciplinary issues (Misconduct, Absence, Policy Violation, etc).
discipline_disciplinetype.institution_relation: NONE: Global system reference data for discipline categorization.
